fields.label: District code
fields.description: 2011 census state code + the boundary file's district code.

fields.label: District
fields.description: District name.

fields.label: State
fields.description: ISO 3166-2:IN state code.

fields.label: Population
fields.description: 2011 census, summed over the 2011 sub-districts that lie in today's district.

fields.label: Households
fields.description: 2011 census.

fields.label: Area
fields.description: Area of the district outline (equal-area projection).

fields.label: Density
fields.description: 2011 population ÷ area.

fields.label: Growth 2001–2011
fields.description: Census A-02, for districts made of whole 2011 districts; Pending where a 2011 district was split.

fields.label: Urban
fields.description: Share of the 2011 population in towns.

fields.label: Literacy
fields.description: Literates ÷ population aged 7 and over (2011 census).

fields.label: Workers
fields.description: Main and marginal workers, 2011.

fields.label: Farm workers
fields.description: Cultivators and agricultural labourers ÷ all workers, 2011.

fields.label: 2011 district
fields.description: The 2011 census district that most of today's district's people lived in.

fields.label: GDP (state's own estimate)
fields.description: District Domestic Product as published by the state's Directorate of Economics and Statistics, at current prices (gross, or net for Tamil Nadu; the year is in gdp_year). Methods differ by state: not comparable across states. Blank where the state's figures are not wired in.

fields.label: GDP year
fields.description: The year of the district GDP figure.

fields.label: GDP measure
fields.description: Gross or Net District Domestic Product.

fields.label: Population 2026 (derived estimate)
fields.description: Derived estimate for 1 July 2026, not a census count: the district's 2011 census count carried forward at its 2001-2011 growth rate (its state's rate where its own is unknown or outside -10% to +60%), then scaled with the state's other districts to the state's official projection (Technical Group on Population Projections, MoHFW).

fields.label: Jobs in establishments (2013)
fields.description: Non-farm employment in establishments at the 2013 Economic Census (MoSPI), via SHRUG, by 2011 sub-district.

fields.label: Establishment jobs per 100 residents
fields.description: Economic Census 2013 employment ÷ the 2011 census population × 100.

fields.label: PM2.5 (µg/m³)
fields.description: Annual mean surface PM2.5, satellite-based estimate (van Donkelaar et al.), via SHRUG, area-weighted over the district's 2011 sub-districts.

fields.label: Households with electricity
fields.description: NFHS-5 (2019-21) district fact sheet of the 2017 district of this name; blank where none matches.
